content.prompt_es: Choose the correct option to complete each sentence using the past continuous tense.
content.explanation: La forma correcta es 'was watching' porque indica una acción que estaba en progreso en el pasado.
content.stimulus_en: While I ___ (watch) TV, my sister was reading a book.

content.prompt_es: Choose the correct option to complete each sentence using the past continuous tense.
content.explanation: La respuesta correcta es 'were playing' porque describe una acción en progreso que fue interrumpida.
content.stimulus_en: They ___ (play) soccer when it started to rain.

content.prompt_es: Choose the correct option to complete each sentence using the past continuous tense.
content.explanation: La opción correcta es 'was walking', indicando que la acción de caminar estaba ocurriendo en ese momento.
content.stimulus_en: I saw her while she ___ (walk) in the park.

content.prompt_es: Choose the correct option to complete each sentence using the past continuous tense.
content.explanation: La respuesta correcta es 'was not listening' para expresar que no estaba prestando atención en ese momento.
content.stimulus_en: He ___ (not listen) to the teacher when she asked him a question.

content.prompt_es: What ___ (you/do) when I called you last night?
content.explanation: La forma correcta es 'were you doing', ya que se pregunta por una acción en progreso en el pasado.

content.prompt_es: What is one of the main causes of climate change?
content.explanation: La deforestación libera grandes cantidades de CO2 en la atmósfera, contribuyendo al cambio climático.

content.prompt_es: Which of the following is a renewable source of energy?
content.explanation: La energía eólica proviene del viento, que es una fuente de energía renovable y no se agota.

content.prompt_es: What can individuals do to reduce pollution?
content.explanation: Reciclar reduce la cantidad de desechos y ayuda a mantener el medio ambiente limpio.

content.prompt_es: Which is an effect of global warming?
content.explanation: El calentamiento global causa cambios en el clima, resultando en patrones meteorológicos más severos.

content.prompt_es: What does biodiversity mean?
content.explanation: La biodiversidad se refiere a la variedad de especies en un ecosistema, lo cual es crucial para su salud.

blocks.title: Listening: Daily routines and healthy habits

content.prompt_es: Listen to the conversation and choose the best answer.
content.question_en: What was Maya's old morning routine like?

options.text: She got up early and exercised.
She got up late and hurried to work.
She walked to work every day.
She always had a long breakfast.

content.explanation: Maya says she used to get up late and rush to work.
content.transcript:
Interviewer: Today we're talking about daily routines. How has your routine changed recently?
Maya: I used to get up late and rush to work. Now I wake up at half past six, have breakfast and walk to the station. It takes a little longer, but I feel much more relaxed.
Interviewer: Do you do anything differently in the evening?
Maya: Yes. I used to spend hours watching television. These days I prepare dinner, go for a short walk and read for twenty minutes. I try not to check my phone just before bed.
Interviewer: Is it difficult to keep these habits?
Maya: Sometimes. When I have a busy week, I don't manage to do everything. I've learned that it's better to make small changes and follow them regularly than to change everything at once.

content.prompt_es: Listen to the conversation and choose the best answer.
content.question_en: How does Maya travel to the station now?
content.explanation: She says that she walks to the station.

content.prompt_es: Listen to the conversation and choose the best answer.
content.question_en: What does Maya do in the evening these days?

options.text: She prepares dinner, walks and reads.
She checks her phone before bed.

content.explanation: Maya describes preparing dinner, taking a short walk and reading.

content.prompt_es: Listen to the conversation and choose the best answer.
content.question_en: What does Maya try to avoid before going to bed?
content.explanation: She tries not to check her phone just before bed.

content.prompt_es: Listen to the conversation and choose the best answer.
content.question_en: What has Maya learned about changing habits?

options.text: It is best to change everything immediately.
Small regular changes are more realistic.
People should never change their routines.

content.explanation: Maya says small changes followed regularly work better than changing everything at once.

content.prompt_es: Read the text and choose the best answer.
content.question_en: Why did Daniel want to change his routine?

options.text: He was moving to another city.
His daily habits were not very healthy.
He wanted to buy a car.
His new job was less demanding.

content.explanation: The first paragraph explains that he skipped breakfast, drove and sat for most of the day.
content.main_text:
A healthier daily routine

When Daniel started his new job, he realised that his daily routine was not very healthy. He often skipped breakfast, travelled to work by car and stayed at his desk for most of the day. In the evening, he was usually too tired to do anything active.

Instead of making several big changes, Daniel decided to begin with two simple habits. He started preparing breakfast the night before and got off the bus one stop earlier so that he could walk for fifteen minutes. After a few weeks, he noticed that he had more energy in the morning.

Daniel also changed the way he spent his evenings. He now cooks at home more often and meets a friend for a walk twice a week. He still has busy days when he cannot follow his plan, but he does not see this as a failure. He simply returns to his routine the next day.

Daniel's experience shows that a healthy lifestyle does not require a perfect schedule. Small, realistic habits can make a difference when people practise them consistently.

content.prompt_es: Read the text and choose the best answer.
content.question_en: What were Daniel's first two changes?

options.text: He joined a gym and stopped working.
He prepared breakfast and walked part of his journey.
He cooked dinner and met a friend.

content.explanation: He prepared breakfast the night before and got off the bus one stop earlier.

content.prompt_es: Read the text and choose the best answer.
content.question_en: What happened after a few weeks?

options.text: He had more energy in the morning.
He no longer felt tired in the evening.

content.explanation: The text says he noticed he had more energy in the morning.

content.prompt_es: Read the text and choose the best answer.
content.question_en: How does Daniel react when he cannot follow his plan?

options.text: He returns to his routine the next day.

content.explanation: He does not see a busy day as a failure and starts again the next day.

content.prompt_es: Read the text and choose the best answer.
content.question_en: What is the main message of the text?

options.text: A healthy lifestyle requires a perfect schedule.
Small realistic habits can improve daily life.
Exercise is more important than sleep.

content.explanation: The final paragraph says small, realistic habits can make a difference when practised consistently.
